'''Arelik Armor''' was a type of personal [[battle armor]] designed by [[Stavren Arelik]] and was used by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It provided moderate protection against attacks and was designed to be fitted with [[Sensor/Legends|sensor modules]]. One drawback was the form-fitting nature of the armor required any [[Power cell/Legends|power cells]] to be mounted to the outside of the armor, making them vulnerable to enemy fire.<ref name="gundark" /> The famed bounty hunter [[Beylyssa]] wore a modified set of this armor equipped with a [[Sensor pod/Legends|sensor pod]], [[Infrared/Legends|infrared]] [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]], a turbo-projected [[Grappling hook/Legends|grappling hook]], a winch, and an environment filter.
